Findings

found &amp; fixed

Variation names were shown in the wrong order ("S / Red" instead of "Red / S")

Found by the browser tests. Variation values are stored as Postgres jsonb, which does not keep key order, so the dropdown, cart and checkout showed the values scrambled. Product responses now restore the seller's attribute order, and order lines (buyer history, seller order list, error messages) use a labelled, sorted format such as "Color: Blue, Size: M".

found &amp; fixed

Image upload "Invalid Signature" on Render

The signing code is correct (the test recomputes the signature with Cloudinary's algorithm and it matches), so the cause is the CLOUDINARY_* environment values on Render (stray space or quotes, or a secret from another key). The server now trims whitespace and quotes from the three values and logs a temporary, secret-free diagnostic line. Needs a redeploy to take effect.

found &amp; fixed

One image per variation option limited the product page gallery

Each option can now hold up to 5 images. Existing listings that stored a single URL per option are converted to a list on read and on save, and the legacy shape is covered by a test.

open

"On sale" has no way to be set

The On sale section shows products carrying the curated "sale" tag, but nothing in the seller or admin screens sets that tag, so on a real database the section stays empty until a discount-price or sale-flag feature is added. The test data tags 30 products directly in the database.

note

Return period differs between pages

The new home-page badge says 14 days (as in the design), while the product page still says sellers accept returns within 30 days.

note

Today's deal depends on sales history

It lists up to 12 most recently sold products, so with few sales it shows fewer than New arrivals. Verified against the API ordering.

Test data & environment

  • A throwaway Postgres schema was created, loaded with db/schema.sql, the admin account, and the project's demo seed (3 categories, 3 buyers, 3 sellers, 8 products, 4 orders), plus extra data: 4 more categories, a 4-option variation product with multiple images per colour, a legacy single-image variation product, and 30 on-sale products. The schema is dropped afterwards.
  • App under test: the production build (next build + next start) on port 3200.
  • Browser: Google Chrome (headless) driven by Playwright.

Not covered

  • Real Cloudinary uploads were not performed (would send files to your live account). Signing, folder scoping and URL validation were tested; the upload form and multi-image UI were checked up to the builder opening.
  • Render deployment itself and the invalid-signature fix can only be confirmed on Render after redeploying with correct environment variables.
  • Email/SMS, payment-gateway and bank-transfer receipt handling are manual processes in this app and not testable here.
  • Visual checks are by DOM measurements and screenshots, not pixel-diff comparison.
